messages:
maria: Heads-up team — soft freeze in 2h for release 1.18.0. Please hold non-critical merges. If you need a late merge, file an exception with justification and risk. Ping here if you have outstanding PRs or urgent bumps.

kevin: I have PR #6128 — deps lockfile update and a minor package bump. Tests green locally. Is that eligible for fast-track or should I formally request an exception?

sophia: If it's only lockfile + package.json and CI is green, we usually fast-track with an approval from an owner. @dave can you take a look? /cc @release-bot for cutoff rules.

release-bot: Cutoff window starts 2026-03-17T16:00Z. Exception requests: `/release exception create --pr 6128 --reason "lockfile update, no runtime changes"` — please include approver(s).

dave: Quick note: docs team needs a changelog line for any user-visible change. If bumping the manifest, add `changelog: true` to the PR body. I'll review 6128 now.

kevin: Added changelog bullet and PR description. Requesting exception now: PR 6128, reason: "lockfile update, no runtime behavior change", risk: low. Tests: all green on CI.

maria: Filing exception: approved by dave in-thread? @dave can you confirm approval so release-bot can mark as exception? :thumbsup:

dave: Approved for merge during cutoff — low risk. Approver: dave. Please include the exception id in the merge commit message.

release-bot: Exception recorded: id ex-20260317-8, approvers: dave. Merge instructions: run `git checkout release/1.18 && git merge --no-ff kevin/pr-6128 && git push origin release/1.18` and include `cherry: ex-20260317-8` in the commit message. Use `--allow-cutoff` flag in the release tooling if prompted.

sophia: Also FYI I pushed a tiny changelog draft to `docs/changelogs/1.18.0.md` and noted the deps bump under "infra".

dave: I'll perform the merge and watch post-merge smoke tests. Command I'll run: `git fetch origin && git checkout release/1.18 && git merge --no-ff refs/pull/6128/head -m "cherry: ex-20260317-8" && git push origin release/1.18`

maria: Thanks all. After merge, ping product for release note signoff. If no regressions after +30m, I'll lift the soft freeze.

kevin: Merged and CI post-merge smoke looks clean (e2e-lite and infra checks passed). Thanks for the quick reviews!

release-bot: Post-merge checks passed (smoke, e2e-lite). Release status: `release/1.18 -> staging`. Exception ex-20260317-8 closed.

maria: Great, closing loop. Everyone please refrain from other non-critical merges until we lift freeze. Will update if anything else pops up.
